activity_summary: At Holy Trinity your mother asked who mends your shirts, and she set your inked forefinger beside your father's alum. She said she would not speak of what you do. Under the responses she said a short grace, and you did not answer it. Your father was not in the pew. Nobody looked at the place. The sword was on the nail at home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the finger was ink, and did not answer the grace.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked about the shirts, said the grace, and would not speak of the trade.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the pew from discussing the empty place, and kept the sword at home.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Found her place in the book, and said she had not turned.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Applied the rule about not looking, and tested whether a short grace still counted.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the sword on the nail, and said so once.

facets.activity: Sat the pew and let the grace pass

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: Who mends thy shirts in London?

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: Thy father's were dyed with alum the same.

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: God keep this house, and the bread, and the hands.

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not speak of what you do.
